original_question: In which year was the hormone associated with hypoaldosteronism first isolated?

final_qi.question: In which year was the hormone associated with hypoaldosteronism first isolated?
final_qi.long_answer: The mineralocorticoid hormone aldosterone—whose deficiency causes hypoaldosteronism—was first isolated in 1953 by Sylvia A. Simpson and James F. Tait (initially called “electrocortin”), establishing its role in sodium retention and potassium excretion.

0.question: What is the hormone associated with hypoaldosteronism?

final_answer.long_answer: Hypoaldosteronism involves deficiency of the mineralocorticoid hormone aldosterone. Aldosterone was first isolated in 1953 by Simpson, Tait and colleagues from human urine, establishing its identity and role in electrolyte and fluid balance.
